Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Choose one visible 3-by-3 area within 5 squares. Make a Reason roll while examining the area. On a Standard result, also reveal how it is activated or sustained.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
One minute of examination.
Target / range / shape
One visible 3-by-3 area within 5 squares.
Type
Magic / Utility

Make a Reason roll while examining the area.

Weak
Locate one magical concealment relevant to your stated search, if one is present.
Standard
Also reveal how it is activated or sustained.
Strong
Also reveal one available way to bypass or end it, if a method exists.
